newsitem.title: USA: ADVO chief financial officer resigns.
newsitem.headline: ADVO chief financial officer resigns.

text.p: ADVO Inc on Tuesday said Lowell Robinson, executive vice president and chief financial officer for the last three years, resigned in order to pursue opportunities in the New York City area, where his family resides.
Robinson joined ADVO in 1994 after serving in senior financial capacities at several companies, including Citicorp.
The company said that a replacement has not been named yet. Robinson will work with its chairman, Robert Kamerschen, through the end of June to affect an orderly transition.
ADVO is a full-service direct-mail marketing services company with annual revenues of almost $1 billion.
